title: Install Playwright browser validation for presentation-agent
measurement_note: Timing record was created after web-first intake and installation had already started, so early phases are recorded as partial or not measured.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official Playwright install, browser, accessibility, and snapshot docs were checked before implementation.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before the timing record was created.

phases.label: Installation and implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added package/config/test files, installed npm devDependencies, and downloaded Chromium browser binaries.

phases.label: Browser validation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Initial sandbox run failed on macOS Mach port permissions; external execution passed after excluding the link index HTML from deck validation.

phases.label: Documentation and history
phases.bottleneck_notes: Updated requirements, workflow, installation records, registry, specs, request traces, and work summaries.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran Python tests, catalog validation, JSON/config checks, npm audit, npm ls, Playwright version, Playwright browser tests, workspace monitor check/test/build, workspace index, and governance health.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The largest estimated cost was installing browser binaries and adapting the test target list after actual execution revealed the link index is not a slide deck.
improvement_candidates: Keep browser validation target discovery tied to .pa-slide so future index pages do not cause false failures.
Run Playwright validation from a normal terminal or approved external execution when using Codex on macOS.
